name: Underdog Saluki 27B 1.0

lineage.how_derived: 2-bit GGUF quantization tuned to keep tool calling intact (IQ2-mix); optional vision add-on

purpose: Qwen3.8-27B in under 8 GB with tool calling kept intact, as a standard GGUF for stock llama.cpp (card).

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0 (the quantized release); base Qwen3.8-27B is Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE read (Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0): non-commercial use, sharing and adaptation with credit; commercial use needs a separate licence from the vendor (card). A LICENSE-APACHE file for the base is shipped alongside.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention dense transformer (Qwen3.8-27B)

variants.notes: mmproj vision add-on F16 928 MB or Q8_0 629 MB; bits per weight computed from 7.89 GB / 27B, not stated

pc-12gb.notes: 7.89 GB file fits the VRAM budget (9.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-16gb.notes: 7.89 GB file fits the VRAM budget (13.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-24gb.notes: 7.89 GB file fits the VRAM budget (21.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-32gb.notes: 7.89 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 7.89 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 7.89 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 7.89 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

strengths: 27B-class model in 7.9 GB: fits 12 GB cards with KV room
tool-calling retention emphasised by the builder
weaknesses: benchmark is the vendor's own and the 'beats the full model' tool-call score is unusual and unverified
2-bit loses on other tasks (96 percent average retention, vendor figure)

tona_fit.reason: The idea (a 2-bit Qwen3.8-27B for 12 GB cards with intact tool calls) is exactly our small-VRAM need, but the benchmark is the vendor's own and we can produce comparable quants from the base ourselves. Compare with our own quant before use.

open_questions: independent tool-calling and coding results at IQ2-mix
how the quant differs from the ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO file it builds on

sources.note: README read, LICENSE read, API file list
